title: pentameris nutans
intro: Pentameris nutans, commonly known as the drooping pentas, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This perennial grass is native to Africa and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pentameris nutans include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antispasmodic effects.
